{"CommandLine":"$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
$toolsDir = "C:\Users\Madziva\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\tools"

# 1. Download OpenJDK 17
$jdkZip = "$toolsDir\openjdk17.zip"
if (-not (Test-Path "$toolsDir\jdk-17*")) {
    Write-Host "Downloading OpenJDK 17..."
    $jdkUrl = "https://github.com/adoptium/temurin17-binaries/releases/download/jdk-17.0.10%2B7/OpenJDK17U-jdk_x64_windows_hotspot_17.0.10_7.zip"
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $jdkUrl -OutFile $jdkZip
    Write-Host "Extracting OpenJDK 17..."
    Expand-Archive -Path $jdkZip -DestinationPath $toolsDir -Force
    Remove-Item -Force $jdkZip
}

# 2. Download Apache Maven
$mvnZip = "$toolsDir\maven.zip"
if (-not (Test-Path "$toolsDir\apache-maven*")) {
    Write-Host "Downloading Apache Maven..."
    $mvnUrl = "https://archive.apache.org/dist/maven/maven-3/3.9.6/binaries/apache-maven-3.9.6-bin.zip"
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $mvnUrl -OutFile $mvnZip
    Write-Host "Extracting Apache Maven..."
    Expand-Archive -Path $mvnZip -DestinationPath $toolsDir -Force
    Remove-Item -Force $mvnZip
}

Write-Host "Setup complete."
